How it works

No forms to fill out alone.
No waiting room to sit in.

1

Tell us how you're doing

Two minutes, honestly answered — mood, stress, sleep, connection, and whatever's actually on your mind.

2

We notice the patterns, not just the words

With your okay, Psyvora looks at the shape of what you shared — never turning it into a label or a diagnosis.

3

You land somewhere that fits

A psychologist-moderated group picked for you, with the reasoning shown plainly — not a black box.

4

Share as much or as little as you want

Post under your name or don't. Read quietly for weeks if that's what you need. There's no "right" pace here.

5

A therapist steps in only if it helps

Never a default, never a sales funnel — just an honest nudge when the pattern genuinely calls for it.

Where you might land

Nine communities. Real people, moderated by a real psychologist.

Before the platform

Real Impact.
Real Conversations.

Long before there was an app, there were rooms full of people willing to talk. Psyvora started with in-person workshops, school sessions, and late-night conversations — the AI came later, to reach the people we couldn't be in the room with.

40+ sessions across schools, colleges, and workplaces — every one of them a reminder that people just want to be heard.

We’re building an AI-powered wellness companion that will help you understand emotional patterns, monitor your mental well-being, and receive personalized insights—all while protecting your privacy.

Built to be trusted

We ask before we look.

Consent-first AI

Every analysis type has its own on/off switch, checked before any model runs.

Encrypted chats

Messages and journal entries are encrypted in transit and at rest, always.

Private communities

Capped membership, moderated spaces — never publicly indexed or searchable.

Delete data anytime

One request removes your account and every piece of associated data, permanently.

GDPR-ready

Built around consent, access, and erasure rights from the ground up.

No data selling

Your data funds a platform you pay for, not an advertiser you never met.
